instruction: Use command-line automation through the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 environment and CAMWorks API; do not use GUI clicks, generic G-code generators, or manual .nc editing/copying. On this machine, SOLIDWORKS CAM/CAMWorks is hosted by `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe`; run the native CAM automation through that installation. Load C:\Users\User\Desktop\slot_channel_part.step and read C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv. Use a single top-side 3-axis milling setup with the supplied tool data to machine the visible straight slots or channels and finish the outside Profile/Contour. Do not use rotary, indexed, or simultaneous 5-axis machining, and do not output A/B/C-axis motion. Save the posted NC output exactly as C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-19.nc.
